khai.tagline: Membership as composite: one persona's standing bind to a group -- the self they draw from it, the standard it bends them to, a mark it would discredit, and the allegiance that raises the cost of leaving -- across the induction, covering, and tether bridges over social-identity, conformity, stigma, and loyalty, and the drama lives where belonging and its price pull apart.

card.wire: Attaches at Process, over four atoms it declares as dependencies. The root (process_membership.md) reads one persona's bind to a group as a web of pulls held across four engines: social-identity supplies the self drawn from the group, conformity supplies the standard it bends the member to, stigma supplies a mark the group would discredit, and loyalty supplies the allegiance that raises the cost of leaving. The composite adds no fifth engine; it wires the seams the atoms refuse to cross.
card.issue: Three bridges, each a handoff the atoms cannot stage apart. Induction: identification draws the self from the group and, in the same motion, brings the member under its standard -- belonging tightening into conforming. Covering: the member carries a mark the very standard they conform to would discredit, so belonging is held by the labor of passing and covering, a self kept partly unseen. Tether: when belonging turns costly, loyalty raises the exit price past what the member will pay, converting what would be a leaving into voice or a swallowed endurance.
card.require: Two altitudes hold the composite. The law: declared once in the project's Instructions Knowledge chapter, linking the root, so the member's-bind read runs wherever its atoms are cast. The link, advisory: a plot may link under Tension the bridge it stages, and the audit surfaces where a play stages the bind without naming it.
card.enforce: Structure is checked; coherence is judged. The kit verifies the floor: the law is declared, the composite's own members conform, and every hard link into the atoms resolves through a declared dependency. Whether a production's belonging and its price genuinely pull apart -- the marked member kept in by a loyalty they cannot spend -- rather than a member who simply fits, is semantic, taught and reviewed, never failed by the suite.
card.setup: Install the composite; its atoms arrive as dependencies and their laws with them. Declare the law in the Instructions Knowledge chapter, linking the root. Cast the member from the atoms -- their belonging from social-identity, their conduct from conformity, their mark from stigma, their allegiance from loyalty -- then stage the bridges: the pull-in and shaping, the mark managed to stay, the tether that holds against leaving. Read the production where the pulls contradict, never in any single engine's reading alone.
